verdicts.reason: A breaks the headline into a strong stacked block, but the right column is messy. The flavour pills are out of their original order (Honey Rosemary comes first) and sit in a ragged 2+1 grid with Blood Orange orphaned on its own row. The oversized CTA competes with the headline, and the legal line is jammed against the bottom edge. B keeps the original's left-aligned structure, pill order and hierarchy, but it crams the CTA inline right next to the subhead, leaving only a small gap. The pill row also stops well short of the right side, leaving the lower-right corner empty apart from the decorative circle.
